snippet.title: Lakeside Bar Trailer (English Ver.)
snippet.description:
Lakeside Bar is an idle bar management simulator that sits at the bottom of your screen (or in fullscreen), letting you run your own bar while doing other things.
- Mix drinks, serve customers, and grow your bar at your own pace.
- Decorate, hire staff, and enjoy smooth jazz in a cozy lakeside setting.
